hook.text: How can a celibate sage have a daughter?

asked.text: A king asked a young hermit woman who she was.

said.text: People call me the sage Kanva's daughter. Hear why.

tapas.text: Long ago, the penance of another sage frightened the king of the gods.

sent.text: He sent Menaka, a nymph of heaven, to break it.

saw.text: Vishvamitra desired her; and she was willing.

left.text: By a river, a daughter was born. Menaka left her there, and went back to heaven.

birds.text: In a forest of lions and tigers, birds ringed the child and kept her safe.

found.text: The sage Kanva found her, and raised her as his own.

name.text: Guarded by birds, by shakuntas: so he named me Shakuntala.

cliff.text: The king listened. A king's daughter, then, he said: be my wife.
